rationale: The Latin anchor *produci* ("to be brought forth/produced") in a botanical/natural context (Psalms 103 and the Phoenix poem both concern natural growth of plants and living things) points to growth by natural process. Among the candidates, grow.v.03 ("increase in size by natural process; Corn doesn't grow here") best captures the intransitive, natural-process sense of plants being produced/grown forth, as opposed to the causative grow.v.04 or the agricultural grow.v.07.
